question: Who among the following was the Viceroy of India during the formation of the Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Lord Dufferin.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Dufferin** was the **Viceroy of India** during the **formation of the Indian National Congress**.
 
• He remained the Viceroy of India from **1884 to 1888**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 __**Indian National Congress (INC)**__

__
 
• INC was formed in **1885** by the initiative of a retired English civil servant **A.O. Hume**.
 
• The **first session of the INC** was conducted in **Bombay from 28 to 31 December** where **W.C. Bannerjee** was the chairperson.
 
• **72 delegates** from all over India attended it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __**Lord Lytton**__

__
 
• Viceroy of India from **1876-1880**.
 
• **Royal Titles Act of 1876 **was passed. Queen Victoria assumed the title of **Kaiser-i-Hind.**
 
• The **Arms Act of 1878 **was passed.
 
• The **Vernacular Press Act of 1878** was passed during his tenure.
 
• **First Delhi Durbar** was organized.

** Lord Ripon__**

__
 
• Viceroy of India from 1880-1884.
 
• The **Vernacular Press Act (1878)** was repealed.
 
• **First Factory Act** was passed during his tenure.
 
• **Ilbert Bill (1883)** was introduced.
 
• **Hunter Commission** came to India in **1882** to reform the Indian education system.

** Lord Mayo​__**

 
• Viceroy of India from **1869-1872**.
 
• He started the **Census**.
 
• The establishment of the Statistical Survey of India took place.
 
• A Pathan** Sher Ali Afridi** assassinated him.
